changes.name: release
changes.impact: Nothing is synced for it: the platform's record and the labels of its objects name the new release.

changes.name: seed.k3s
changes.impact: The k3s binary on the seed VM is replaced and k3s is restarted. The seed's API is away for about a minute. Meanwhile only reconciliation stops: Cluster API replaces or repairs no machine, the seed's ArgoCD syncs none of the platform's own components, and no platform run goes on. The platform cluster, every tenant cluster, the tenant API servers and the databases keep serving. ArgoCD and Cluster API on the seed keep their state: etcd on the seed's disk is not touched.

changes.name: seed-k3s-job
changes.impact: A privileged Job on the seed downloads the binary, checks its sha256 and restarts k3s. The run deletes the Job after it has read its result.

changes.name: seed-etcd-snapshot
changes.impact: The Job first saves a snapshot of the seed's etcd (k3s etcd-snapshot save). It is kept: k3s's own snapshot retention applies.

changes.name: seed-k3s-binary
changes.impact: The binary is replaced only after the download passed its sha256. The install script is not run again: the unit and /etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml stay.
